大嫂子 is sister-in-law, not biological elder sister.
Both Baoyu and Yuchuan watch visitors, not each other.
葬花吟 wording matches reviewed27 while source 春尽 versus 春残 remains distinct.
checkedAndRetained: All 45 prose blocks retained including poem embedded within prose; no invented poem boundary.
Widowed mother/younger brother comparison, parrot imitation and Daiyu solitude preserve speaker perspective.
Xue Pan apology, bows, saliva and promises remain character actions; no narrator endorsement.
Four silver molds, chi/cun dimensions, thirty-forty designs, ten bowls, four chopstick places and standing service retained.
Ying/Xi arrivals distinguished from Ying/Yuchuan carrying soup; old servant carries it until gate.
Fu Qiufang23, Ying16, two attendants, two dishes and half of two fruit kinds retained.
